title: fagara chevalieri
intro: Fagara chevalieri, commonly known as Chinese prickly ash, is a species of flowering plant in the family Rutaceae. It has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to aid in digestion, relieve respiratory issues, and lower blood pressure. The therapeutic actions of Fagara chevalieri include its analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties, making it a useful remedy for various ailments. The bioactive constituents of this plant include coumarins, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
